title: Refactor billing webhook handler for idempotency
description: Adds X-Request-Id-based idempotency to /webhooks/billing/* per ADR-014. Closes follow-up from INC-2025-02 — the renewal webhook handler was missed during the post-ADR audit. Idempotency cache uses Redis with 24h TTL as specified. Audit emission is updated to include the idempotency-hit flag.
diff:
diff --git a/billing-api/src/handlers/webhooks.py b/billing-api/src/handlers/webhooks.py
index 1a2b3c4..5d6e7f8 100644
--- a/billing-api/src/handlers/webhooks.py
+++ b/billing-api/src/handlers/webhooks.py
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@ from billing_api.audit import emit_audit_event
 from billing_api.payments import create_charge
 from billing_api.subscription import renew_subscription
+from billing_api.middleware.idempotency import idempotent
 
@router.post('/webhooks/billing/subscription-renewal')
+@idempotent(cache_seconds=86400)
 async def handle_renewal(req: WebhookRequest):
     subscription = await renew_subscription(req.subscription_id)
     charge = await create_charge(subscription)
-    await emit_audit_event('subscription.renewed', subscription_id=req.subscription_id)
+    await emit_audit_event('subscription.renewed', subscription_id=req.subscription_id, idempotency_hit=False)
     return {'status': 'ok', 'charge_id': charge.id}
